summaryBox.title: Hydrogen Bonding
summaryBox.takeaway: Intermolecular: raises boiling point (p-nitrophenol, H₂O). Intramolecular (chelation): lowers boiling point, steam-volatile (o-nitrophenol). Ice floats due to 3D open-cage tetrahedral network.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
o-NITROPHENOL vs p-NITROPHENOL
                     
   o-Nitrophenol (Intramolecular H-Bond)       p-Nitrophenol (Intermolecular H-Bond)
   ├── 6-Membered Chelate Ring                 ├── Linear Polymer Association
   ├── Steam Volatile                          ├── Non-steam Volatile
   └── Lower Boiling Point (214°C)             └── Higher Boiling Point (279°C)
conceptBreakdown.content: • **Open-Cage Structure of Ice**: In ice, each $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ molecule forms 4 directional tetrahedral H-bonds, creating wide open interstitial cages. Density of ice is lower than liquid water at $0^\circ\text{C}$ (ice floats). Maximum density of water occurs at $4^\circ\text{C}$.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 8.2 10 High-Yield NEST Chemical Bonding Traps
conceptBreakdown.title: 8.2 10 High-Yield NEST Chemical Bonding Traps
conceptBreakdown.content:
1. **TBP Lone Pairs**: In $sp^3d$, lone pairs and multiple bonds ALWAYS occupy equatorial positions ($33.3\%\ s$).
2. **$\text{NH}_3$ vs $\text{NF}_3$**: $\text{NH}_3 (1.47\text{ D}) > \text{NF}_3 (0.23\text{ D})$ because bond dipoles reinforce the lone pair in $\text{NH}_3$.
3. **$\text{O}_2$ Paramagnetism**: $\text{O}_2$ has 2 unpaired electrons in $\pi^* 2p$ antibonding MOs (proved by MOT).
4. **Intramolecular H-Bonding**: LOWERS boiling point by preventing intermolecular association ($o$-nitrophenol).
5. **$s-p$ Mixing**: In $\text{N}_2$ ($Z \le 7$), $\sigma 2p_z$ is higher in energy than $\pi 2p_{x,y}$.
6. **$\text{XeF}_6$ Shape**: $\text{XeF}_6$ ($6\text{ bp} + 1\text{ lp}$) is Distorted Octahedral in gas phase.
7. **$\sigma$ vs $\pi$ Strength**: $\sigma(p-p) > \pi(p-p)$ due to axial vs lateral overlap.
8. **$\text{CO}^+$ Bond Order**: $\text{CO}^+$ has anomalous $BO = 3.5$ (higher than $\text{CO} = 3.0$).
9. **Participating $d$-Orbitals**: $dsp^2$ uses $d_{x^2-y^2}$; $sp^3d$ uses $d_{z^2}$; $sp^3d^2$ uses $d_{x^2-y^2} + d_{z^2}$.
10. **$\Delta_{\text{eg}} H_2$ Endothermicity**: Always positive ($+780\text{ kJ/mol}$ for $\text{O}^- \rightarrow \text{O}^{2-}$).

quickRevision: o-Nitrophenol is steam-volatile with lower BP due to intramolecular H-bonding.
Ice has open-cage structure; max density of water is at 4°C.
XeF₆ is Distorted Octahedral (6 bp + 1 lp).
